# ConstantRegularization { #phasic.svgd.ConstantRegularization }

```python
phasic.svgd.ConstantRegularization(regularization=0.0)
```

Constant regularization (default behavior).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**regularization**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Fixed regularization strength for all iterations

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> schedule = ConstantRegularization(1.0)
>>> schedule(0)  # iteration 0
1.0
>>> schedule(100)  # iteration 100
1.0
```
